products.name: Mustard Oil Cold Pressed
products.shortDescription: Traditional cold-pressed mustard oil for authentic taste.
products.description: Mustard Oil Cold Pressed is produced from carefully selected yellow mustard seeds using mechanical pressing rather than solvent extraction, which helps preserve the oil's characteristic nutty aroma and natural compounds associated with traditional Bengali cooking. It is especially prized for fish curries, pickles (achar), stir-fried greens, and tempering dal—applications where the sharp, warming note of mustard oil defines authenticity. The cold-pressed approach aims for a cleaner flavour profile compared with heavily refined oils, while food-grade packaging protects the product from light and oxygen during everyday kitchen use. Before first use in shallow frying or seasoning, some cooks prefer to heat the oil gently to smoking point for a few seconds and cool slightly, following regional practice; otherwise use as directed in your favourite recipes. Keep the bottle capped and in a cool pantry to maintain freshness across weeks of regular cooking.
